description: Archil Jaliashvili discussed hemoglobin, microcirculation and three years of BHOC experience with the Abu Buneba veterinary team in Tbilisi on November 16, 2026.
heading: Precision Oxygen Therapeutics Lecture at AB-Vet Buneba in Tbilisi
lead: On November 16, 2026, Archil Jaliashvili presented Precision Oxygen Therapeutics to the veterinary team at AB-Vet Buneba in Tbilisi, Georgia. The lecture and discussion focused on how oxygen is carried in the blood and delivered to tissues.

sections.heading: What did the veterinary lecture cover?
paragraphs: Jaliashvili described blood as a functional organ and examined one of its functions, oxygen transport. He discussed how hemoglobin binds and releases oxygen and how blood flow through the smallest vessels affects its delivery to tissues.

Three years of hands-on experience with investigational BHOC (Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier) gave the group practical observations to discuss. That experience has shaped the questions the team asks about tissue oxygenation in veterinary medicine.

sections.heading: Questions from veterinary practice
paragraphs: The veterinarians made time for the lecture after a full day of seeing patients. Their questions and observations turned the session into a discussion of how the biochemistry relates to everyday veterinary practice.
BHOC Veterinary thanks David Nanobashvili, PhD, and the entire AB-Vet Buneba team for sharing their experience and making time for the conversation.
